messages.snippet: James, Sarah, Good news - the Caldera Mobility change-of-control consent letter came through today,
messages.subject: Cedar - Caldera consent received
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Sarah,

Good news - the Caldera Mobility change-of-control consent letter came through today, dated 28 April. That clears the main contractual condition. I've added it to the disclosure bundle at tab 7.1 and noted it in the diligence report. The Aerelon renewal heads of terms are also agreed.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
